slides.texte_overlay:
5 signs a man is quietly
disciplined
1. He goes to bed on time. No late scrolling, no last episode. He knows tomorrow's discipline starts tonight. Sleep is part of the plan.
2. He eats well most of the time. Not perfect, just consistent. Simple meals, enough protein, few excuses. Food is fuel.
3. He keeps his space in order. Bed made, dishes done, desk clear. Order around him supports order in his head. Small order, big calm.
4. He saves before he spends. A fixed amount every month, without thinking about it. Discipline with money gives him calm.
5. He learns a little every day. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and small daily habits like this add up to real change.
slides.texte_sophia: 5. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Small daily habits like this add up to real change.

slides.texte_overlay: Bonus: he doesn't talk about it. No speeches about grinding. His results speak for him. He just does the work, day after day, while others talk about it.
Quiet discipline isn't harsh. It's a calm, steady way of taking care of your life, every single day. Calm and steady wins.
